pre_repair.stem:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I (Big Five factor)
(A) Neuroticism
(B) Extraversion
(C) Conscientiousness
(D) Agreeableness

List-II (Characteristics)
(I) Trusting, altruistic, modest
(II) Anxious, hostile, depressed
(III) Organised, dutiful, self-disciplined
(IV) Warm, gregarious, assertive

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
